entries.name: Mayo
entries.description: A roughly 1.2 km depression with a scalloped rim and a comparatively flat floor.
entries.qualification: Approximate location transferred from Stardust’s named-feature image.

reference.title: Brownlee et al. (2004), Surface of Young Jupiter Family Comet 81P/Wild 2, Fig. 2

entries.name: Left Foot
entries.description: A double depression with flat floors and steep cliffs. Its northern lobe is about 650 m wide and 140 m deep.
entries.qualification: Approximate location transferred from Stardust’s named-feature image.

reference.title: Brownlee et al. (2004), Surface of Young Jupiter Family Comet 81P/Wild 2, Fig. 2

entries.name: Right Foot
entries.description: A roughly 1 km depression, deeper and less flat than Left Foot. Its southeast rim exposes more than 150 m of cliff.
entries.qualification: Approximate location transferred from Stardust’s named-feature image.

reference.title: Brownlee et al. (2004), Surface of Young Jupiter Family Comet 81P/Wild 2, Fig. 2
